description: Backend Developer specializing in GoLang, contributing to the development and maintenance of critical services within the Acquiring business line.

Specialized in Backend development within a distributed microservices architecture. Developed and maintained high-performance services using GoLang, leveraging gRPC for efficient inter-service communication and Kafka for building event-driven systems. Ensured data integrity and application reliability using PostgreSQL and the Uber Fx dependency injection framework.

Developed and maintained a complex, high-availability payment gateway responsible for processing millions of transactions. Implemented critical financial features, including recurring billing systems, advanced fraud prevention mechanisms, and a chargeback notification system. Utilized GoLang for performance-critical components and high-load payment processing.

Developed key backend services for a high-tech marketplace in the gaming sector. Implemented complex two-way integration with major gaming platforms, including Steam and Valve, to facilitate secure and efficient trading of virtual in-game items. Utilized GoLang as the primary language for building high-performance, low-latency services.

Developed core components for one of the largest medical data collection systems in the USA. Strictly adhered to modern engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles. Contributed to the PCI DSS certification process, validating experience in building and maintaining secure systems for handling sensitive data.

Developed and maintained mission-critical internal systems, including a CRM solution and an Internal Portal, utilizing PHP and GoLang on the backend. Designed and optimized a high-volume mass mailing system, leveraging RabbitMQ for message queuing and Redis for efficient caching, ensuring performance and reliability.

Full-cycle development of a sophisticated mobile application marketplace, focusing on critical backend systems including billing, detailed user statistics collection, and account management. Utilized Zend Framework 1 and Symfony 1 to ensure system stability and scalability.
Technical implementation of SEO optimization strategies. Development and maintenance of website functionality.
